name: What is the maintenance required for easy access drawers?

mainEntity.name: What is the maintenance required for easy access drawers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Easy access drawers are designed for low maintenance. Generally, they only require occasional cleaning with a damp cloth and mild soap. The ball-bearing slides are engineered for smooth, long-lasting performance and typically do not require lubrication. Avoiding overloading the drawers beyond their weight capacity helps maintain their functionality. Should any issues arise, our installation includes a warranty on workmanship and materials.
acceptedAnswer.description: Easy access drawers require low maintenance, primarily occasional cleaning. Ball-bearing slides are designed for long-term, smooth operation without lubrication.
